paper: From Flat to Hierarchical: Evolving Tree-structured Thoughts for Fine-grained Alpha Mining
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored deterministic TreEvo-style search over explicit hierarchical factor trees using pre-common JKP history; not the paper's Qwen-generated thought/code population and not a reproduction of its SPX, NDX, or CSI results.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Represent every candidate alpha as a whole hierarchical thought tree whose root is the overall factor, internal nodes are compositional subcomponents, and leaves are fine-grained operations or inputs.
Evolve bounded subtrees with crossover, root mutation, internal-node mutation, fine leaf mutation, and pruning so global exploration and local refinement occur at distinct structural levels.
Maintain a population of ten candidates, generate ten offspring, evaluate executable factors, and retain the ten best parents or offspring until a 200-evaluation budget is exhausted.
Use chronological train, validation, and test periods; train/search on predictive IC or RankIC, then apply the selected factor out of sample.

tree_grammar.leaf: one signed cross-sectional JKP feature rank
tree_grammar.expression_interpretation: every internal node composes complete child subtrees and the root emits one stock score

evolution_policy.training_direction: orient each candidate by the sign of its training-period mean RankIC
evolution_policy.training_fitness: absolute mean training RankIC minus 0.0001 times node count beyond one
evolution_policy.population_selection: best training fitness with expression-lexical tie-breaking from each parent-plus-offspring pool
evolution_policy.final_selection: highest mean validation RankIC after applying the training-period direction among the final population
evolution_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: apply the one frozen selected tree to every common month, then use value-weighted long-short deciles and all six cost/missing-return paths

preserved_elements: a whole hierarchical tree as each candidate thought
root, internal-node, and leaf levels with explicit compositional dependencies
root, internal, and fine mutation scopes with 0.4/0.4/0.2 probabilities
approximated_elements: six point-in-time JKP price, trend, turnover, and volatility ranks replace OHLCV/vwap arrays
a deterministic typed tree grammar replaces LLM-generated textual thoughts
direct recursive evaluation replaces the unavailable thought-to-code prompt and parser
seeded programmatic operators replace Qwen prompt-level evolutionary calls
a pre-1999 train-validation split replaces the paper's 2016-2021 search periods
the common monthly decile portfolio replaces daily Top-50/Drop-5 execution
invented_elements: the mean, difference, and product internal-node grammar
the random seed and exact initial-tree generator
